title: Lena and the Smile
author: Lior Winterbourne
blurb: Lena Nakamura, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, has spent twenty years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must get the family out ahead of the count before the last resident signs the papers.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
